# dragIT

> Enterprise software delivery by Zoran Dragicevic, PhD — Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations implementation, migration and real-time observability (Mission Control: Azure Data Explorer/KQL, Application Insights), custom software (Portal) and IT/AI strategy for industry. Named engagements: Ragn-Sells, ArcelorMittal, Boksit, Drina. Based in Bosnia and Herzegovina, delivering across the region and the EU.
